Description: Bureau of Meteorology Station Number.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to the station number of the weather station taking the measurements.
  • Commonly referred to as Location in our database.

Description: Day month year in DD/MM/YYYY format.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to the day, month, and year that the measurement was recorded. Typically displayed in YYYY-MM-DD format.
  • Commonly referred to as Date in our database.

Description: Precipitation in the 24 hours before 9am (local time). In mm.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to the total amount of rainfall recorded, in millimetres, in the past 24 hours before 9am local time.
  • Commonly referred to as Precipitation in our database.

Description: * Quality of precipitation value.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to the quality of the Rainfall data recorded, and whether or not the measurement is quality controlled. Refer to the dataset FlagQuality for definitions of specific quality flags.
  • Commonly referred to as PrecipitationQual in our database.

Description: Number of days of rain within the days of accumulation.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to how many days of rainfall were recorded within the amount of days measured, as our data is recorded per day, this value is typically 1, 0, or has no value.
  • Commonly referred to as RainDaysNum in our database.

Description: Accumulated number of days over which the precipitation was measured.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to the total number of days over which the rainfall was measured. As our data is recorded per day, this value is typically 1, or has no value as no measurement was taken on a given day.
  • Commonly referred to as RainDaysMeasure in our database.

Description: Evaporation in 24 hours before 9am (local time). In mm.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to the amount of evaporation measured in the last 24 hours before 9am (local time), in millimetres.
  • Commonly referred to as Evaporation in our database.

Description: * Quality of evaporation in 24 hours before 9am (local time).
NTRLDescription:

  • Commonly referred to as EvaporationQual in our database.

Description: Days of accumulation for evaporation.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to the total number of days over which the related measurement was taken. As our data is recorded per day, this value is typically 1, or has no value as no measurement was taken on a given day
  • Commonly referred to as EvapDaysNum in our database.

Description: Maximum temperature in 24 hours after 9am (local time). In Degrees C.
NTRLDescription:
This attribute refers to the maximum temperature recorded in 24 hours before 9 am (local time), and is measured in Degrees C.
